tonight.headline: Wilson's first cover left in a walking boot
body: Bad news first: Denzel Boston, the first cover for Garrett Wilson's slot, left the Browns' facility in a walking boot after Friday's practice (Mary Kay Cabot, via Heavy/Yahoo 13 Nov 22:15Z; DraftSharks 21:13Z) — reported after Friday's brief went out. Monken still calls the toe 'trending in the right way'; he is questionable. Wilson is still questionable with one protocol step left (newyorkjets.com 13 Nov); nothing newer had been reported by this morning. Diggs' 20.3 on your bench is the bar that slot has to beat.

Likely banked 27.7; Nicky Jam have Daniels' 20.8. ESPN: 148.1 to 118.6, 66%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup — nothing to tap today. One check, Sunday 10:30 CDMX: Wilson, then Boston. Their Kenneth Walker (26.2) missed Friday's practice with a groin and is questionable (NBC 13 Nov; NFL.com report).

case.label: Their side
case.body: Walker's groin broke Friday, after ESPN set his 26.2 — that number is not priced. Carnell Tate is OUT (Titans report) and still in their WR slot at 0.0; A.J. Brown (questionable, ankle/knee) and Jalen Coker sit on their bench to replace him.

case.label: Your check
case.body: If Wilson is inactive at 10:30: Boston if Boston is active, otherwise DK Metcalf, who kicks off at 19:20 and is still movable after the noon games lock. Both Jets and Browns inactives land at 10:30.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The Jets ruling Wilson out on Saturday — then the check becomes a Saturday swap. Boston downgraded or ruled out on Saturday — then Metcalf is the only cover. Walker active and healthy — then the 66% is ESPN's honest number.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · check Sun 15 Nov 10:30 CDMX
doFirst.title: If Wilson is inactive, start Boston — or Metcalf
doFirst.subtitle: Wilson starts. This is the plan if the protocol's last step fails — and Boston's boot makes Metcalf likelier.

case.label: The check
case.body: Wilson was full Friday; Glenn: 'one more step to go through before he's cleared' (newyorkjets.com 13 Nov). No clearance reported by Saturday morning. Concussion clearance needs an independent neurologist, so the answer can come Saturday or not until inactives.

case.label: The cover
case.body: Boston (12.8, toe) missed Wednesday and Thursday, was limited Friday, then left in a walking boot that may be precautionary (Cabot via Heavy 13 Nov 22:15Z; DraftSharks 21:13Z). ESPN's 12.8 has not moved since Friday afternoon, so the boot is not priced. If he is inactive too, Metcalf (10.6) plays Sunday night at Cincinnati and can still be moved in after noon.

case.label: Who is throwing
case.body: Boston: Deshaun Watson, off the Browns' report and starting (fantasysixpack 14 Nov). Metcalf: Aaron Rodgers; Derrick Harmon is the Steelers' only player with a status (NFL.com Week 10 report).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wilson is inactive and the cover scores under Diggs' 20.3 — the Tuesday swap then closes WRONG on its outcome, whatever this card does. The card itself is wrong only if Metcalf outscores Boston after Boston was chosen.

whatWentWrong.title: Diggs scored 20.3 on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: The Tuesday swap put Wilson in on a 2.0 projection edge. Diggs then drew 10 targets and scored the winner.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Wilson 12.8 against Diggs 10.8 on Tuesday — exactly 2.0, labelled PROJECTION. Diggs: 10 targets, 6 catches, 20.3 (archive), the late touchdown in a 24-21 win (VAVEL 12 Nov).

case.label: Why it was still the call
case.body: Diggs played Thursday, so the slot had to be set before Wilson's status was known. The projection lineup is the policy; the backtest found nothing that beats it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wilson (or his cover) scores 20.3 or more — then the swap closes RIGHT. Below it, WRONG on the outcome. Either way it is one decision, not a pattern.
